sentences.text: By virtue of this petition, petitioner is claiming payment of compensation in lieu of land which is taken over by respondent No.2 and construction of road is started.
This compensation is sought under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act.
It is pointed out that the act of the respondents is violative of Article 300- A of the Constitution of India.

This matter involves disputed question of facts as to when road was constructed, how much land of the petitioner has gone into road etc., therefore, petitioner will be free to move a representation to the respondent No.2 and 3 for demarcation of his land and upon demarcation, if it is found that any land of the petitioner has come under the road constructed, then he will be free to move an application for compensation before the Collector, Sidhi, who shall decide the same within ninety days of said demarcation taking place.
It is directed that demarcation be carried out within a period of thirty days from the date of receipt of certified copy of the order being passed today.
It is made clear that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
In above terms, this petition is disposed of.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE Tabish Rajesh Kumar Lodhi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64578283/
